pool.notes: Whole-list IMPORT pool; each qualifying faction (power >= 8, by power) contributes its FIRST unsuppressed good (CHAIN_SUPPRESSES by active chain id). tier >= village is guaranteed by TIER_DEMAND_BUDGET (thorp/hamlet budget 0). Culture is the caller's culture string with a latin fallback, so culture is declared per row (except latin). Faction category presence: unhomed: faction category government (powerStructure.factions[].category, power >= 8); unhomed: faction category economy (merchant/guild faction, power >= 8); unhomed: faction category military (power >= 8); unhomed: faction category religious (power >= 8); faction category magic declared as "magic" (magic functions); the faction itself is unhomed; faction category criminal declared as "crime" (deriveCriminalStructure non-null — a DIFFERENT reader from the faction roster; confirm with chair). Producers are elsewhere (imports) and not declared. Line 189's government/isGoverning ternary is a no-op (both arms 'government').
